brand.heading: Shop from many sellers, in one cart
brand.body: Find what you need, pay once, and follow every order in one place.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to keep shopping on HiveSpace.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.message: For your security, sign in again to continue.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Shop and sell on HiveSpace. It takes a minute.
register.noticeSubtitle: Your account is created. One more step.
register.noticeBody: We sent a verification link to {email}.
register.noticeValid: The link works for 24 hours. Check your spam folder if you do not see it.

verify.expiredBody: Request a new one below. Only the newest link works.
verify.expiredAlertBody: Links work for 24 hours, or until you ask for a newer one.
verify.invalidBody: It may be incomplete. Copy the full link from the email, or request a new one.
verify.networkTitle: We could not verify your email. Try again.
verify.sentAgain: If this address needs verifying, a new link is on its way.

banner.message: Verify your email to place orders. We sent a link to {email}.

errors.passwordRules: Your password does not meet the rules below.

external_login_denied.title: Google sign-in cancelled
external_login_denied.message: You cancelled the Google sign-in. Try again, or sign in with your email and password.

external_email_unverified.title: Google email not verified
external_email_unverified.message: Google could not confirm this email address, so we cannot sign you in with it. Use another Google account, or sign in with your email and password.

external_login_failed.title: Google sign-in failed
external_login_failed.message: We could not complete the Google sign-in. Please try again, or sign in with your email and password.

external_login_unavailable.title: Google sign-in unavailable
external_login_unavailable.message: Google is not available right now. Sign in with your email and password, or try again later.

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.message: Too many sign-in attempts from this network. Wait a minute, then try again.
